oil.when: 2023 (Oil Control System in the gauge-cluster display Settings menu)
steps: Reset only after the engine oil and filter have actually been changed.
Park, set the parking brake and switch the vehicle to ON without starting the engine.
Press the display buttons on the left of the steering wheel until Settings shows between the gauges.
Turn the scroll dial to Maintenance and push the dial to open it.
Select Oil Control System and push the dial, then follow the reset prompt at the bottom of the screen.
If you also set an Oil and Filter reminder distance, open that item and reset it too.
oil.note: The Oil Control System works out its own interval. Resetting it before the oil is changed hides when the next change is due.

oil.when: 2016–2019 (Oil and Filter reminder in the display Settings > Maintenance menu)
steps: Reset only after the engine oil and filter have actually been changed.
Stop the vehicle, set the parking brake and turn the ignition to ON.
Use the arrow buttons on the left of the steering wheel to reach Settings in the display between the gauges, then press OK.
Choose Maintenance, then Oil and Filter, pressing OK each time.
Choose the reset option to restart the reminder from zero. You can also change the reminder distance on the same screen.
oil.note: This reminder is a distance you set yourself, not an oil-life sensor. Match it to the interval in your maintenance schedule. Checked in the 2016 and 2019 owner's manuals.

tpms.when: 2023 (no reset button; Easy Fill Tire Alert helps while filling)
steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the driver's door jamb sticker.
To use Easy Fill Tire Alert: press the brake, put the vehicle in P, set the parking brake and switch to ON without starting the engine.
Start adding air. Within a few seconds the hazard lights begin flashing.
Stop when the horn beeps once and the hazards stop flashing. That tire is at the label pressure.
Drive above 16 mph (25 km/h). The light goes out once the system has read the new pressures; it does not go out the moment you add air.
tpms.note: If the light flashes for about a minute and then stays on, the system has a fault or a wheel without a sensor (such as the spare) is fitted. A reset will not clear it; have it checked.

If the light stays on after a few miles, recheck all four pressures with a gauge.
tpms.note: If the light flashes for about a minute and then stays on, the system has a fault or a wheel without a sensor (such as the spare) is fitted. A reset will not clear it; have it checked. Checked in the 2016 and 2019 owner's manuals.
